# Expert Fence

> Expert Fence (Expert Fence LLC) is a fence contractor and fence supplier in Alexandria, Virginia, serving Washington DC, Northern Virginia and suburban Maryland since 1986. It installs residential and commercial fences with its own in-house crews, fabricates custom gates, railings and ornamental metalwork in its own shop, and sells contractor-grade fence materials with delivery across the DMV.

- Address: 6027 Farrington Avenue, Alexandria, VA 22304
- Phone: (703) 751-3008
- Email: expertfence@expertfence.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–4:30 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Founded: 1986
- Licensing: Virginia Class A Contractor License #2705136172; Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) #105954; licensed in Washington DC. Bonded and insured.
- Ratings: A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau
- Free on-site estimates with written, itemized quotes. Permits and HOA applications are handled by Expert Fence.
- Installation is never subcontracted.
- Languages: English and Spanish

## Services

- [Wood & Cedar Fences](https://www.expertfence.com/wood-fence-installation.html): Cedar and pressure-treated wood privacy, horizontal and picket fences built by in-house crews since 1986. Alexandria, Arlington, Fairfax, DC and Maryland.
- [Vinyl Fences](https://www.expertfence.com/vinyl-fence-installation.html): Vinyl privacy, picket and semi-privacy fences that never need staining. Installed by Expert Fence crews across Northern Virginia, DC and Maryland since 1986.
- [Aluminum & Steel Fences](https://www.expertfence.com/aluminum-fence-installation.html): Powder-coated ornamental aluminum and steel fences and gates for homes, pools and communities. Installed and fabricated by Expert Fence in Alexandria, VA.
- [Pool Fencing](https://www.expertfence.com/pool-fence-installation.html): Code-compliant pool fences with self-closing, self-latching gates for homes, HOAs and community pools across Northern Virginia, DC and Maryland.
- [Chain Link & Security](https://www.expertfence.com/chain-link-fence-installation.html): Residential and commercial chain link, welded wire and perimeter security fencing with slide and cantilever gates. Expert Fence, Alexandria VA, since 1986.
- [Custom Gates & Automation](https://www.expertfence.com/custom-gates.html): Custom wood and metal driveway gates, arched walk gates and automated gate operators, fabricated in our Alexandria shop and installed across the DMV.
- [Fence & Gate Repair](https://www.expertfence.com/fence-repair.html): Fence and gate repair across the DMV: rotted posts, storm damage, sagging gates and rusted ornamental bases repaired instead of replaced. Free estimates.
- [Railings & Fabrication](https://www.expertfence.com/railings-metal-fabrication.html): Custom metal railings, ornamental ironwork, gates and welded repairs fabricated in the Expert Fence shop in Alexandria and installed across DC, MD and VA.
- [Fence Supply & Materials](https://www.expertfence.com/fence-materials-supply.html): Contractor-grade cedar, pressure-treated, vinyl, aluminum and chain link fence materials and hardware. Pickup in Alexandria or delivery across DC, MD and VA.
- [Staining & Sealing](https://www.expertfence.com/fence-staining-sealing.html): Wood fence cleaning, staining and sealing on a two-to-three-year cycle. Protect cedar and pressure-treated fences in the DMV climate. Free estimates.
- [Residential Fencing](https://www.expertfence.com/expert-fence-residential.html): Fence options for homeowners compared side by side.
- [Commercial Fencing](https://www.expertfence.com/expert-fence-commercial.html): Fencing for contractors, builders, HOAs, property managers and municipal clients.

## Service area

Washington, DC, Alexandria, VA, Arlington, VA, Fairfax, VA, Falls Church, VA, McLean, VA, Vienna, VA, Springfield, VA, Annandale, VA, Burke, VA, Woodbridge, VA, Reston, VA, Herndon, VA, Great Falls, VA, Bethesda, MD, Silver Spring, MD, Rockville, MD, Potomac, MD, Chevy Chase, MD, College Park, MD, Bowie, MD, Upper Marlboro, MD, Laurel, MD, Gaithersburg, MD, and surrounding communities inside the Capital Beltway and up to about an hour outside it.
